intro: Lesson 14. Read each word slowly, pointing with your finger. Only the Arabic is the Qur'an; the English is a translation of its meaning.

arabic.text: فَإِذَا نُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ نَفْخَةٌۭ وَٰحِدَةٌۭ (١٣) وَحُمِلَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَٱلْجِبَالُ فَدُكَّتَا دَكَّةًۭ وَٰحِدَةًۭ (١٤) فَيَوْمَئِذٍۢ وَقَعَتِ ٱلْوَاقِعَةُ (١٥) وَٱنشَقَّتِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ فَهِىَ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ وَاهِيَةٌۭ (١٦) وَٱلْمَلَكُ عَلَىٰٓ أَرْجَآئِهَا ۚ وَيَحْمِلُ عَرْشَ رَبِّكَ فَوْقَهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ ثَمَٰنِيَةٌۭ (١٧) يَوْمَئِذٍۢ تُعْرَضُونَ لَا تَخْفَىٰ مِنكُمْ خَافِيَةٌۭ (١٨)

فَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ بِيَمِينِهِۦ فَيَقُولُ هَآؤُمُ ٱقْرَءُوا۟ كِتَٰبِيَهْ (١٩) إِنِّى ظَنَنتُ أَنِّى مُلَٰقٍ حِسَابِيَهْ (٢٠) فَهُوَ فِى عِيشَةٍۢ رَّاضِيَةٍۢ (٢١) فِى جَنَّةٍ عَالِيَةٍۢ (٢٢) قُطُوفُهَا دَانِيَةٌۭ (٢٣) كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ هَنِيٓـًٔۢا بِمَآ أَسْلَفْتُمْ فِى ٱلْأَيَّامِ ٱلْخَالِيَةِ (٢٤)

head: Ayah
Translation of the meaning (Saheeh International)
rows: Then when the Horn is blown with one blast And the earth and the mountains are lifted and leveled with one blow -
Then on that Day, the Resurrection will occur, And the heaven will split [open], for that Day it is infirm.

And the angels are at its edges. And there will bear the Throne of your Lord above them, that Day, eight [of them]. That Day, you will be exhibited [for judgement]; not hidden among you is anything concealed.
So as for he who is given his record in his right hand, he will say, "Here, read my record! Indeed, I was certain that I would be meeting my account."
So he will be in a pleasant life - In an elevated garden,
Its [fruit] to be picked hanging near. [They will be told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you put forth in the days past."

questions.q: Chunk and link Al-Haqqah 69:13-24 together, ayah by ayah.
questions.a: The class recites 69:13-24 together without the mushaf.

questions.q: Listening rota: today's group recites 69:13-24 to the teacher, one by one. Everyone else: 3-3-link the same ayat, then tick the revision log.
questions.a: Pupil recites with no help; the teacher marks hifdh and tajweed on the rubric and gives one target.

questions.q: In the portal box, list what the people of the garden enjoy in 69:21 to 24.
questions.a: A pleasant life, a lofty garden, fruit near at hand, eating and drinking in satisfaction.

questions.q: Find the ikhfa examples in 69:17 to 18.
What does the one with the record in his right hand say (69:19)?
options: I wish I had not been given my record
questions.a: A) Here, read my record!. 69:19. The second option is what the one with the left hand says (69:25).

questions.q: Al-Haqqah 69:22: «فِى جَنَّةٍ ...» Which word comes next?
Think again: Imagine being handed a book of everything you have ever done. What would you want it to say?
questions.a: The one given his book in his right hand says joyfully 'Here, read my record!' (69:19), because he expected his account (69:20).
